meanings: “Hallo” is a common German greeting. It means “hello” and is used to greet someone in both casual and neutral situations.

pronunciation.text: HA-loh (like “HAH-loh”). The first syllable is short, the final “o” is an open “oh”.
pronunciation.instruction: Click the mic or click {{key|space}} and say: “{{audio|Hallo}}”.

lines.text:
This cell is my new home.
I was jailed for not speaking German in Germany.
Logic... or absurdity?

I don’t want to do anything.
I don’t want to think.
I just want to sleep.

Prisoner Josef G.
My name is Marlene Weiss.
I am the jailer responsible
for the wing of non-German speakers.

You may only speak your native language when I allow it.
You will only leave this place when you speak German.
And you will only eat if you SPEAK GERMAN.

At the first hour of the morning
I will give you a German test.
The subject will be GERMAN GREETINGS.

You will receive your meal
only if you pass the test.
If you fail,
hunger will improve your motivation.

But… I have no books.
I have nothing in this cell
to learn German.

That is not my problem.
It is time to sleep. The lights will be turned off.
I will return early tomorrow with your test.

I don’t want to do the challenge now.
I’d rather sleep before meeting that terrible woman.

I don’t want to do anything at the table right now.
I just want to sleep...
I don’t want to do anything at the table right now.

We won’t have any food until we win the language challenge.
Forget it. I just want to sleep
It’s not time to eat yet.

It looks like I need to be careful with my food.
There’s a rat here
I don’t want to mess with that right now.
What do you want to do?

alternatives.text: Try to sleep before the test

lines.text: You have things to do before you go to sleep.

Wait a second...  
Could it be that I died...  
And became a Ghost?

Does that mean I don’t need
to go back to that prison anymore?

You didn’t die, Josef — don’t get so smug. ♦  
You’re only dreaming that you’re dead, a ghost. †

Whose voice is this?  
Who are you?

Walk a bit further, and open your eyes. †
Then you will see me, darling — lucky you. ♦

A confessional… with a nun?
Who are you?
What is happening?

Don’t overthink it, Josef.
That’s not your strength.
You’re dreaming.

I… I don’t understand.
Why am I here?
Why are you here?

You can call me "Masked Nun".
The “why” comes later.
Now: you need to learn German.

Learn… in a dream?
And if I wake up…
I’ll forget everything.

You won’t forget what matters.
Pass today’s test and you eat.
Fail it… and you don’t.
Now… let’s begin, Josef. †
Josef, learning a new language is like growing a plant.

First, you plant the seed.
Then you nurture it, again and again.
And when the time is right...
you harvest it.

Since we are inside your head,
I can make that process quite literal.

The first word I will cultivate
inside this empty little garden of yours
is “Hallo”.

There… that is enough for today, Josef.
You did well.
Better than I expected. †

Leve os seus pequenos conhecimentos
Um pouco mais a frente
Para o Lago da Memória
Onde eles crescerão com saúde †

Hello, dreamer.
I am the Guardian of Memory.
I see you bring small pieces of knowledge to me.

If you correctly remember the name of each piece of knowledge,
it will be sent to the Lake of Memory,
and Mnemosyne will take care of it...

But if you fail to remember it correctly, or have forgotten it completely,
it will be sent to the Lake of Forgetfulness,
into the arms of Lethe.

A train...?
How did I get here?
